query:
SELECT e.id, e.description, e.amount, e.supplierId, e.categoryId, ec.name as categoryName
FROM expenses e
JOIN expenseCategories ec ON e.categoryId = ec.id
WHERE e.status != 'CANCELADA' 
  AND YEAR(CONVERT_TZ(e.createdAt, '+00:00', '-03:00')) = 2025
  AND MONTH(CONVERT_TZ(e.createdAt, '+00:00', '-03:00')) = 12
  AND ec.name = 'Custo Operacional'
ORDER BY e.createdAt DESC
